positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: TA for course intended to provide students with a solid technical foundation for developing, animating, and controlling characters used in interactive computer games, virtual reality simulations, and high-end animation applications.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Joined the wireless devices team responsible for building a next-generation software platform for connecting, controlling, and maintaining fixtures and fixture controllers.
• Lead a project on extracting logs and diagnostics from embedded devices via a TLS-over-BLE connection.
•	Designed a data transfer protocol used between embedded devices and the client-facing app for commissioning and extracting logs
• Worked extensively with C/C++ and RTOS programming, including unit testing and mocking (w/ CppUTest), as well as Python to build an end-to-end solution for diagnostics extraction.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: TA for course that focuses on issues and programming models related to cloud & distributed data processing technologies: data partitioning, storage schemes, stream processing, and “mostly shared-nothing” parallel algorithms

company.name: Student Federal Credit Union at the University of Pennsylvania

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Integrated 2 business management APIs (MINDBODY & Booker) to automate the business transaction flow (booking process).
• Hired, on-boarded, and managed 3 external frontend developers to improve the UI & UX of redesigned mobile app.
• Maintained and improved the company’s backend server and business logic, including documenting the server’s public endpoints and performing basic penetration testing to uphold its security.

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
• Increased application usage by redesigning the B2C interaction and integrating a communication API, Twilio, to automate the creation of appointments being made by customers.
• Developed an admin dashboard with a login system to manage databases and the status of appointments via a GUI.
